verdict.rationale: Delegated access is a fair question for a state business-filing agency, which could publish rules on who may file or sign for an entity. The evidence pack never describes what a third party (filer, attorney, service company) may or may not do on an entity's behalf, any role definitions, or which signatures must stay personal. The only authorization form mentioned is the Credit Card/Debit Card Authorization Form, which covers payment, not delegation of filing authority.
